name: 99301 · Pasco, WA
findings: ZIP 99301 (Pasco) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99301 (Pasco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
